cards.task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

wrong.why: Does not react to the fall and reaches the exit without the box.
Waits until the box has fallen, then walks to the exit without picking it up.
Does nothing: the box falls and stays on the floor.

paraphrases: Take the box to the exit. Each time the box falls, pick it up on your very next move.
Reach the exit with the box in your hands, and if the box falls, pick it up again on the very next move.
Get to the exit carrying the box; every time the box falls, your very next move must pick it up again.
cards.notes: Carry version of `tpl-chain-response-1-goal`: the agent starts holding the box, cannot put it down before the first fall, and the box falls at a step from 2 to 8 drawn from the seed (the fall turns the agent to face it), so the box rule always triggers and a next-move pickup is always possible. Same task and clauses; the solving policy waits in place for the fall and picks the box up.
